test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 7 boys P, Q, R, S, T, U and W are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). No one is to the right of Q. R is fourth to the left of Q. W is second to the left of R. T is fourth to the right of U. P is not second to the right of U. Who is sitting to the immediate right of P?
solution:
**Given:**7 boys P, Q, R, S, T, U and W are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order).

1. No one is to the right of Q.

2. R is fourth to the left of Q.

3. W is second to the left of R.

4. T is fourth to the right of U.

5. P is not second to the right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b16e287e7a58011b093962aaae4b2cf62d8a14c7b354040669e4af63687cf3e9.png] 

S, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20fc6bff230bc718caceb0d166b3b71c1f14c83f36b729cd87d2e152c308d98d.png] 

Thus, T is sitting to the immediate right of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
